relationships.subject: intervertebral disc degeneration
relationships.evidence_quote: From the etiology of LBP, intervertebral disc degeneration (IDD) is mainly responsible for the LBP

key_findings: Review: circRNAs act as ceRNAs regulating inflammation, ECM metabolism and nucleus pulposus cell apoptosis in disc degeneration.
circRNAs are proposed as diagnostic indicators and therapeutic targets for IDD.
